item.title: Benicia High boys basketball team holds off Berean Christian
item.description: WALNUT CREEK – In some ways, Friday’s game was a microcosm of Benicia High School’s entire boys basketball season. The Panthers showed flashes of brilliance and a balanced attack, but they also suffered from periods of inconsistency. Benicia did just enough to dispatch host Berean Christian, 76-67, in an up-tempo Diablo Athletic League contest.
